name: sertaconazole
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE ERTACZO ® cream, 2%, is indicated for the topical treatment of interdigital tinea pedis in immunocompetent adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older caused by Trichophyton rubrum , Trichophyton mentagrophytes, and Epidermophyton floccosum . ERTACZO cream, 2% is an azole antifungal indicated for the topical treatment of interdigital tinea pedis in immunocompetent adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older caused by Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes , and Epidermophyton floccosum . ( 1 )
pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of ERTACZO cream, 2%, have not been established in pediatric patients younger than 12 years of age.
